title: RefraktConfig
description: Project-level configuration for refrakt.md. Three valid shapes — flat (legacy, deprecated in v0.12, slated for removal in v1.0), singular `site`, plural `sites` — all collapse to a canonical normalized form internally. The unversioned URL https://refrakt.md/refrakt.config.schema.json is a 'latest' alias that always serves the most recently published schema.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference, for editor completion and validation.

plugins.description: Plugins for this project — npm packages that contribute runes, layouts, pipeline hooks, behaviors, and/or CLI commands and MCP tools. When set, this is authoritative; when absent, plugin discovery falls back to scanning package.json for @refrakt-md/* dependencies.

xrefs.description: Cross-reference URL templates. Patterns are tried in array order when an xref's ID isn't found in the registry (or when the registry-found entity has no usable `sourceUrl`). First match wins.

fileRoots.description: Named file roots — directories that file-reading runes can reach via a `namespace:filename` syntax (e.g. `{% partial file="shared:footer.md" /%}`). Keys are namespace names; values are paths relative to the project root and must point at existing directories. The namespace `site` is reserved.

sites.description: Multi-site declaration keyed by site name. Mutually exclusive with `site`.

theme.description: Legacy shorthand for sites.default.theme. Accepts either a package name string (legacy shorthand) or a full SiteThemeConfig object with `package`, `presets`, `tokens`, `modes`, and `code.colorScheme`.

target.description: Legacy shorthand for sites.default.target. Documentation-only — no adapter consumes this field. Slated for removal in v1.0.

overrides.description: Component overrides, mapping a `typeof` name to a component path relative to the project root.

routeRules.description: Route-to-layout mapping rules, evaluated in order — first match wins. A rule may also set `entity`, registering matching pages as registry entities of that type (e.g. `runes/**` → `rune`) without per-page frontmatter.

search.description: Whether to render the site-wide search UI (header button + Cmd/Ctrl+K dialog, powered by Pagefind). Defaults to true. Set false to omit the search chrome entirely. Results require a Pagefind index built and served at /pagefind/ — see the Setting up search guide.

icons.description: Custom icon SVGs, merged into the theme's global icon group and referenced by name.

backgrounds.description: Named bg presets (keyed by name). Each is a BgPresetDefinition: `style` and/or token-driven `gradient` (engine-resolved), `extends` a base preset, and/or `sandbox` ({ src, framework?, dependencies? }) for a live sandbox backdrop resolved at transform time (SPEC-104). `sandbox` presets are project-level content.

baseUrl.description: Public base URL of the site, used for canonical links, `og:url` and `og:image`.

siteName.description: Human-readable site name, used for `og:site_name` and Organization JSON-LD.

defaultImage.description: Default `og:image` for pages that do not set their own. 1200×630 is recommended.

logo.description: Site logo path used in Organization JSON-LD (e.g. `/favicon-192.png`).

repoUrl.description: Legacy shorthand for sites.default.repoUrl. Canonical GitHub (or compatible) repository URL — e.g. `https://github.com/owner/repo`. Used by the `file-ref` rune to build deep-link `View source` URLs.

repoBranch.description: Legacy shorthand for sites.default.repoBranch. Git ref appended to GitHub source URLs (branch / tag / commit SHA). Defaults to `main`. Use a commit SHA for archival URLs that won't drift when the file is edited later.

dir.description: Plan directory, relative to project root. Default: 'plan'

SiteConfig.description: Configuration for one site — the unit a build renders. A single-site project declares one under `site`; a multi-site project declares several under `sites`.

contentDir.description: Path to the content directory, relative to the project root. Required for a site to load.

theme.description: Active theme — accepts a package name string (legacy shorthand) or a full SiteThemeConfig with presets, token overrides, mode overlays, and code-block colour scheme.

target.description: Documentation-only adapter hint (svelte, astro, next, nuxt, eleventy, html). No adapter validates or reads this field today; it serves as an in-config record of the intended adapter. Slated for removal in v1.0.

overrides.description: Component overrides, mapping a `typeof` name to a component path relative to the project root.

routeRules.description: Route-to-layout mapping rules, evaluated in order — first match wins. A rule may also set `entity`, registering matching pages as registry entities of that type (e.g. `runes/**` → `rune`) without per-page frontmatter.

entityRoutes.description: Declarative entity → page routes. Each rule generates one page per registered entity matching `type` plus an optional `filter` — the built-in alternative to writing a `contributePages` pipeline hook by hand.

search.description: Whether to render the site-wide search UI (header button + Cmd/Ctrl+K dialog, powered by Pagefind). Defaults to true. Set false to omit the search chrome entirely. Results require a Pagefind index built and served at /pagefind/ — see the Setting up search guide.

icons.description: Custom icon SVGs, merged into the theme's global icon group and referenced by name.

plugins.description: Plugins to merge into this site's ThemeConfig (runes, layouts, hooks, etc.).

locale.description: Active locale (BCP 47, e.g. `de`). Selects first-party and plugin translation bundles for framework-generated UI text and drives locale-aware date/number formatting. Defaults to `en`.

strings.description: Site-level translation overrides for framework-generated UI text, keyed by the auto-derived i18n key (`{scope}.{block}.{ref}`). Highest precedence — these win over first-party and plugin bundles. Each value is a string, or a map of CLDR plural categories (`one`, `other`, …) to strings.

tints.description: Project-level tint presets, available to any page or rune via the `tint` attribute.

backgrounds.description: Named bg presets (keyed by name). Each is a BgPresetDefinition: `style` and/or token-driven `gradient` (engine-resolved), `extends` a base preset, and/or `sandbox` ({ src, framework?, dependencies? }) for a live sandbox backdrop resolved at transform time (SPEC-104). `sandbox` presets are project-level content.

baseUrl.description: Public base URL of the site, used for canonical links, `og:url` and `og:image`.

siteName.description: Human-readable site name, used for `og:site_name` and Organization JSON-LD.

defaultImage.description: Default `og:image` for pages that do not set their own. 1200×630 is recommended.

logo.description: Site logo path used in Organization JSON-LD (e.g. `/favicon-192.png`).

repoUrl.description: Canonical GitHub (or compatible) repository URL — e.g. `https://github.com/owner/repo`. Used by the `file-ref` rune (SPEC-078) to build deep-link `View source on GitHub →` URLs of the form `{repoUrl}/blob/{repoBranch}/{path}#L{start}-L{end}`. When absent, `file-ref` falls back to a no-href link / in-page anchor with a build warning.

repoBranch.description: Git ref appended to GitHub source URLs — accepts any branch name, tag, or commit SHA. Defaults to `main` when omitted. Use a commit SHA for archival URLs that won't drift when the file is edited later.

RouteRule.description: One route-to-layout mapping. `pattern` is a glob matched against a page URL; `layout` names the layout to apply. An optional `entity` also registers matching pages as registry entities of that type.

pattern.description: Glob-style pattern matched against the page URL (e.g. `docs/**`, `**`).

layout.description: Name of the layout to use (a key in manifest.layouts).

entity.description: Register pages matching this pattern as registry entities of this type, in addition to their `page` registration (SPEC-092). A page's own frontmatter `type` overrides the rule — this types a whole section by convention (e.g. `runes/**` → `rune`) without per-page frontmatter.

SandboxConfig.description: Sandbox configuration — the runtime program-source directory scanned at build time (SPEC-104, ADR-022).

dir.description: Directory of sandbox program sources, relative to the project root.

examplesDir.description: Renamed to `dir` (ADR-022). Still accepted — the config normalizer coalesces it into `dir` and emits a deprecation warning — but slated for removal.

EntityRoute.description: One declarative entity → page route. Generates a page per registered entity matching `type` (plus optional `filter`), and back-fills each matched entity's `sourceUrl` with the generated route so `{% ref %}` prefers the on-site page.

type.description: Entity type(s) the rule matches, comma-separated for multiple.

filter.description: Optional `field:value` filter using the same grammar as the `collection` rune's `filter` attribute (e.g. `status:ready`).

url.description: Templated route, site-root-relative (the site's basePath is applied by the loader). `{name}` placeholders interpolate from the entity's fields — e.g. `/specs/{id}/`. Each substituted value is URL-encoded per path segment.

title.description: Templated page title. Falls back to the rendered content's heading when omitted.

render.description: Inline markdoc body transformed per entity with `$item` bound — e.g. `{% expand $item.id /%}`. Mutually exclusive with `render-template`.

render-template.description: Markdoc partial used as the body instead of `render` — e.g. `templates:decision-page.md`. Mutually exclusive with `render`.

frontmatter.description: Frontmatter for the generated page. `{name}` placeholders interpolate from the entity's fields.

XrefPattern.description: One cross-reference resolution pattern — turns an unresolved xref ID into a URL.

match.description: Regex matched against the ID. Anchored to a whole-string match by default (`^` and `$` are auto-applied unless already present). Named groups `(?<name>…)` are extractable in `template` and `label` as `{name}`.

template.description: URL template. Supports `{id}` (the full matched ID) and `{name}` for named groups. Each substituted value is URL-encoded per path segment.

type.description: Entity type reported for links resolved through this pattern.

label.description: Label template for the generated link. Supports the same `{id}` / `{name}` placeholders as `template`.

HighlightConfig.description: Legacy syntax-highlighting configuration — picks a Shiki built-in theme by name (or a `{ light, dark }` pair) for fenced code blocks. The recommended modern approach is `theme.presets` (which contribute `--rf-syntax-*` token overrides via Lumina syntax presets like `@refrakt-md/lumina/presets/nord`) plus `theme.code.colorScheme` for forced light/dark code blocks. Kept for back-compat; both mechanisms can coexist.

theme.description: Built-in Shiki theme name (e.g. `github-dark`), or a `{ light, dark }` pair for dual-theme support that switches with the site's light/dark mode.

SiteThemeConfig.description: Per-site theme configuration with token overrides, presets, modes, and code-block colour-scheme behaviour. The legacy string form (`"theme": "@refrakt-md/lumina"`) is shorthand for `{ "package": "@refrakt-md/lumina" }`.

package.description: Active theme — npm package name (e.g., `@refrakt-md/lumina`) or relative path.

presets.description: Preset modules merged into the theme in declared order (last wins per token). Each entry is a module identifier (npm package + export path) resolving to a token preset — e.g. `@refrakt-md/lumina/presets/niwaki` for palette presets, `@refrakt-md/lumina/presets/nord` for syntax-colour presets.

colorScheme.description: Initial colour scheme behaviour for the rendered site. `auto` (default) respects user preference (saved or system); `light` / `dark` force the scheme regardless of preference.

tokens.description: Site-level token overrides applied on top of the theme's base values and any presets. Validated against the theme's TokenContract at build time. Nested by token category (e.g. `color`, `space`, `radius`).

modes.description: Site-level per-mode overlays (e.g. `dark`). Layer on top of the theme's modes and any preset modes. Keys are mode names; values are partial token contracts.

colorScheme.description: Force fenced code blocks to a fixed colour scheme regardless of the page's light/dark mode. `auto` (default) lets code follow the page mode; `light` / `dark` stamp `data-color-scheme` on each `<pre>` so the cascade picks that scheme's syntax token values — useful for an always-dark code aesthetic on light pages (Stripe / Vercel style) without a parallel override stylesheet.

RunesConfig.description: Rune resolution — which package wins when several define the same rune name, extra tag names for existing runes, and runes loaded from local files.

prefer.description: Which package wins when several define a rune of the same name, mapping rune name to package. Use `"__core__"` to force the built-in core rune to take precedence.

aliases.description: Additional tag names resolving to an existing rune, mapping alias to rune name. Useful for site-specific shorthand, or for keeping a previous tag name working.

local.description: Rune implementations loaded from local files rather than a published package, mapping rune name to file path. Paths resolve relative to `refrakt.config.json`.
